profile.name: Wasatch SPI光谱仪
profile.description: 通过 FT232H USB 转 SPI 转换器通信的 Wasatch 光谱仪，用于触发采集、读取光谱数据，并设置积分时间、探测器增益及 EEPROM/FPGA 相关参数，常用于拉曼或通用光谱测量系统。
profile.description_en: A Wasatch spectrometer controlled through an FT232H USB-to-SPI interface. It is used to trigger acquisitions, read spectral data, and configure integration time, detector gain, and EEPROM/FPGA-related settings in Raman or general spectroscopy setups.
